column1: Line of Sight: It is line drawn from eye of an observer to point in object viewed by observer.
Angle of Elevation: Angle of elevation of object viewed is angle formed by line of sight with horizontal, when it is above horizontal level, i.e. the case when we raise head to look at objects.

Angle of Depression: Angle of depression of an object viewed is angle formed by sine of sight with horizontal when it is below horizontal level, i.e. the case when we lower our head to look at objects.
The height or length of object: A distance between 2 objects can be determined with help of trigonometric ratios.
